meta.subject: Parcel.status

states.label: Created
states.description: Booked and labelled, still on the merchant's shelf

states.label: Collected
states.description: In Relay's hands, not yet sorted

states.label: At depot
states.description: Sorted and waiting for the next leg

states.label: In transit
states.description: On a trunk vehicle between two depots

states.label: Out for delivery
states.description: On a van, with a sequenced stop and a promised window

states.label: Attempt failed
states.description: Nobody in, or no safe place. Back to the depot tonight.

states.label: Awaiting instruction
states.description: Parked until the recipient chooses what happens next

states.label: Delivered
states.description: Handed over, or left in the agreed safe place with a photo

states.label: Returned
states.description: Back with the merchant. Charged as a failed delivery.

states.label: Cancelled
states.description: Withdrawn before Relay ever took it

states.label: Lost
states.description: No scan for ten days. A claim is opened automatically.

cards.title: Why it is shaped like this
items: Two delivery attempts, then the parcel stops moving until a human decides — vans are the scarce resource, not warehouse shelves
Lost is recoverable: parcels turn up, and a found parcel rejoins at the depot that scanned it

cards.title: Watch out
items: Scans arrive out of order from offline handhelds, so a transition can be evaluated against a scan older than the current state
Only a scan moves a parcel forward. There is no manual status edit, by design.
